response:
Dan's separation pay is computed based on retrenchment to prevent losses (authorized cause under Article 298 of the Labor Code). The separation pay is the higher of:
- One (1) month pay, or
- At least one-half (1/2) month pay for every year of service.

A fraction of at least six (6) months is considered one (1) whole year. Dan has 7 years and 5 months of service; since 5 months is less than 6 months, it is not counted as a full year. Thus, his creditable years of service = 7 years.

**Computation:**
- Monthly rate = ₱24,600
- One-half month pay = ₱24,600 × 0.5 = ₱12,300
- Separation pay (1/2 month pay per year) = ₱12,300 × 7 years = ₱86,100
- One month pay = ₱24,600

The higher amount is ₱86,100.

FINAL ANSWER: ₱86,100.00
